correctness.rationale: In the middle environment both voter jump directions have positive rates wherever the destination exists; since S can reach and leave the middle, this proves irreducibility even at a=0. Center the count at μ=(a+β z̄)/c. Its drift is −c(X−μ)+β(z−z̄); for the centered environmental eigenmodes z_j with rates η_j and variances V_j, the product generator has no simultaneous-jump term. Stationarity gives Cov(X,z_j)=βV_j/(c+η_j). Orthogonality under (1/4,1/2,1/4) yields V_1=1/8 and V_2=(1−2δ)²/16. The quadratic variation rate of the count fraction is H(X,z)/N with the stated H. Thus 2c(v_N−V_∞)=E[H]/N, and E[H]=H_0−2q v_N−2c V_∞; solving gives v_N−V_∞=κ/(Nc+q). The same identity proves positivity directly: H is nonnegative everywhere and strictly positive in the middle environment, which has stationary probability 1/2. The drift equation for the stationary PDMP gives the same environmental cross moments and v_∞=V_∞ with no jump-variation term. At lag t, the exact covariance solves C_N′+c C_N=β Σ_j Cov(X,z_j)e^{−η_j t}, with C_N(0)=v_N; the PDMP solves the identical inhomogeneous equation with C_∞(0)=V_∞. Integration gives the stated kernels, including (1+ct)e^{−ct} when c=η_j, and the strictly positive single-rate difference for each finite t≥0. This also proves monotonicity in N. Independent rational generator calculations reproduced the N=10 example and derivatives through order 3 in that example and at both nonzero-mode resonances.
residual_risks: The lag-derivative computation is bounded corroboration, not a proof at arbitrary lag; the linear covariance equation supplies the all-lag result. Fixed rates, autonomous environment and stationarity are essential to this argument.

value.rationale: The covariance is directly interpretable as memory of the fluctuating opinion fraction. The result isolates precisely what changing N can change, with sign, rate, exact amplitude and behavior at resonances, without solving an unavailable stationary density or relying on leading-size approximations. That is a usable exact invariant of the existing, physically motivated influencer model.
residual_risks: No results for full stationary laws, arbitrary starting states, sparse graphs or switching coefficients that change the count drift slope.
